build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone from torchvision with configurable depth 18, 34, 50, or 101
build_fpn_backbone: build a ResNet FPN backbone registered in detectron2 BACKBONE_REGISTRY with torchvision or MSRA ResNet
run_resnet_forward: run the ResNet forward pass to extract multi-scale feature maps p2 through p6
review_resnet_out_features: review the ResNet class output feature channels and strides for p2 to p6 levels
refactor_resnet_depth: refactor the ResNet class to support additional ResNet depths beyond 18, 34, 50, and 101
